name: Nirvana

whyMatters.en: Aberdeen/Seattle trio whose Nevermind (1991) made quiet-loud dynamics and anti-idol posture the early-90s alternative default on MTV and rock radio.
whyMatters.zh: 阿伯丁/西雅图三人组：Nevermind（1991）让强弱动态与反偶像姿态成为 90 年代初 MTV 与摇滚电台的 alternative 默认。

note.zh: 强弱动态成为 1991 青年电台占领语法。

note.en: Delay-tinged hook; alternative enters mass rock radio.
note.zh: 偏延时钩子；alternative 进入大众摇滚电台。

note.en: In Utero-era closer: fragile vocal over restrained band.
note.zh: In Utero 时期收束：克制乐队上的脆弱人声。

interviewQuotes.text: I'd rather be hated for who I am, than loved for who I am not.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Kurt Cobain
interviewQuotes.source: Widely circulated interview excerpt · quote wall

interviewQuotes.text: We don't want to be the next Beatles. We just want to be Nirvana.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Krist Novoselic

lyricQuotes: All in all is all we are

shortBio.en: Cobain / Novoselic / Grohl grunge; Smells Like Teen Spirit is the 1991 switch.
shortBio.zh: Cobain / Novoselic / Grohl 的 grunge；Smells Like Teen Spirit 是 1991 年开关。

body.en:
Formed 1987; Bleach (1989) precedes the peak trio with Dave Grohl (1990). Nevermind (Butch Vig) and In Utero (Albini) bookend mainstream takeover and pushback.

Quiet verse / loud chorus, Cobain’s melodic under noise, Novoselic’s elastic bass, Grohl’s hard kick. Influence is measurable in 1990s radio formats and in bands that copied the dynamics more than the reluctance.
body.zh:
1987 年组建；Bleach（1989）早于 Dave Grohl（1990）加入的巅峰三人组。Nevermind（Butch Vig）与 In Utero（Albini）标记主流占领与反推。

轻主歌/响副歌、噪声下的 Cobain 旋律、Novoselic 弹性贝斯、Grohl 硬底鼓。影响可在 1990 年代电台格式与大量只抄动态、难抄「不情愿」的乐队中度量。

body.en:
After Teen Spirit, US rock radio briefly shares playlist space with underground ethics. Nirvana matter because they pair punk roughness with hard-rock weight, then refuse the usual hero script in interviews and videos.

The chronicle gains a template: mass fame that documents its own discomfort.
body.zh:
Teen Spirit 之后，美国摇滚电台短暂与地下伦理共用播放列表。Nirvana 要紧，因为他们把朋克粗糙与 hard-rock 重量配对，又在访谈与录像里拒绝常规英雄剧本。

编年史多了一种模板：记录自身不适的大众成名。

title.zh: Bleach 前期 vs 经典三人组

body.en:
Chad Channing–era Bleach is the Sub Pop document. Cobain, Novoselic, and Grohl lock the fingerprint the world cites—short run, high citation density.

Earlier drummers matter to collectors; MTV-scale memory starts with Grohl’s kit.
body.zh:
Chad Channing 时期的 Bleach 是 Sub Pop 文献。Cobain、Novoselic 与 Grohl 锁死世界引用的声纹——周期短、引用密度高。

早期鼓手留给收藏家；MTV 尺度的记忆从 Grohl 的鼓组开始。

title.en: Teen Spirit: dynamics as radio grammar
title.zh: Teen Spirit：动态成为电台语法

body.en:
Quiet-loud is not new (Pixies are cited). MTV and rock radio amplify it until a Seattle trio becomes default 1990s programming.

Cheerleader satire in the video is part of the media event; the musical switch is the drop into distortion.
body.zh:
强弱动态并不新鲜（常引 Pixies）。MTV 与摇滚电台把它放大，直到西雅图三人组成为 1990 年代默认编排。

录像里的啦啦队讽刺是媒介事件的一部分；音乐开关是切入失真的那一下。

title.en: Melody under sludge, kick as punctuation
title.zh: 淤泥下的旋律，底鼓作标点

body.en:
Cobain’s tunes sit under fuzz; Novoselic’s bass is melodic and wide; Grohl’s kick arrives like a hard cut. Later bands often copy the dynamic shape alone.

What travels less easily is the public refusal of rock-star cosplay.
body.zh:
Cobain 的旋律坐在 fuzz 下；Novoselic 贝斯宽而旋律化；Grohl 底鼓像硬剪辑。后来乐队常只抄动态外形。

较难复制的是公开拒绝摇滚明星扮相。

title.zh: 舞台音量旁的访谈否定

body.en:
Short circulated lines keep the oral tension: fame argued with in public. The wall quotes are evidence of posture, not tragedy merch.

Read them against the records: the contradiction is part of the historical object.
body.zh:
流传短句保留口述张力：当众与成名争辩。墙上引语是姿态证据，不是悲剧周边。

对照唱片阅读：矛盾是历史对象的一部分。

body.en:
Britpop answers with brighter chords. Indie keeps DIY scale. Radiohead chooses studio mutation over flannel costume.

Nirvana remain the early-90s hinge: later acts salute or flee the template.
body.zh:
Britpop 用更亮和弦回答。Indie 守住 DIY 尺度。Radiohead 选择录音室变异而非法兰绒戏服。

Nirvana 仍是 90 年代初铰链：后来者致敬或逃离该模板。

note.en: Bleach-era lineup before the Grohl trio.
note.zh: Grohl 三人组之前的 Bleach 时期阵容。

note.en: Peak trio the catalog cites; Grohl’s exit path starts here.
note.zh: 目录引用的巅峰三人组；Grohl 的离开路径自此开始。

note.en: Quiet-loud structure as global rock-radio default.
note.zh: 强弱结构成为全球摇滚电台默认。

note.en: Underground ethics meet MTV scale within one release cycle.
note.zh: 地下伦理在同一发行周期内撞上 MTV 尺度。
